Montreal Communiqué 


Vv 


August 5, 1970 
For release at will 


The Montreal YMCA's Downtown Residence and Kamp 
Kanewana will be the main bases for a British contingent 
of unofficial goodwill ambassadors to visit this 
Province, August llth-16th. 

The group, sponsored by W.H. Rhodes Canada Education 
Trust,will consist of 44 students--age 16-19--and two 
masters. Their objective is to establish personal 
contacts here, create friendship and strengthen existing 
ones. 

The first two anda half days will be spent at 
Kanawana, the Y's summer resident camp at Saint-Sauveur. 

They will return to Montreal on Friday, August 14th, 
at noon, leaving for Britain on Sunday, August 16th at 
5:00 p.m. 

While in Montreal they will tour the city, visit 
McGill University, the National Film Board and Man and 
His World. 

= Ai 


For further information please contact: Bill Sher 
849-5 331
